dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「授業があるのもあと一日だけど、ちゃんと遅
　刻しないで来るんだぞ……じゃあ週番、号令」
dialogues.en:
"There's just one more day of classes left, so make sure
you're not late for school tomorrow. ...Weekly duty, rise."
dialogues.text:
"There's just one more day of classes left, so make sure
you're not late for school tomorrow. ...Weekly duty, rise."

dialogues.jp: 挨拶がすむと、教室から暦先生の姿が消える。
dialogues.en:
After her usual farewell, Koyomi-sensei's figure disappeared
from the classroom.
dialogues.text:
After her usual farewell, Koyomi-sensei's figure disappeared
from the classroom.

dialogues.jp:
クラスの中では、卒業式の後の卒業パーティー
や休み中の計画についての会話がなされている。
dialogues.en:
All around the class, everyone was talking about the
graduation party and how they're preparing for it.
dialogues.text:
All around the class, everyone was talking about the
graduation party and how they're preparing for it.

dialogues.jp: さて、俺はどうしようかな……。

明日に最後の授業を控えて、暦先生は今日のＨ
Ｒを終らせた。
dialogues.en:
With a reminder that tomorrow was the last day of classes,
Koyomi-sensei ended HR.
dialogues.text:
With a reminder that tomorrow was the last day of classes,
Koyomi-sensei ended HR.

dialogues.jp:
クラスでは卒パの話題で持ちきりだが、俺はど
うしようかな。
dialogues.en:
The class was talking about the graduation party, but what
should I do.
dialogues.text:
The class was talking about the graduation party, but what
should I do.
